question:
What is the value of

\[3+\cfrac{1}{3+\cfrac{1}{3+\frac13}}?\]
solution:
Evaluate the innermost denominator first, then work outward. The successive values are
\[
3+\frac13=\frac{10}{3},
\]
\[
3+\frac{1}{10/3}=3+\frac3{10}=\frac{33}{10}.
\]
Therefore the full expression equals
\[
3+\frac{1}{33/10}=3+\frac{10}{33}
=\boxed{\frac{109}{33}},
\]
which is choice \(\mathrm{D}\).
